html: II. עלם (√ of foll.; perhaps orig. be mature (sexually); Aramaic עֲלֵם be strong, ܥܰܠܶܡ rejuvenate (certainly denom.), Arabic غَلِمَ be lustful (id.); cf. Sab. עֿלם, עֿלמן young man CISiv. pp. 30, 42, Arabic غُلَامٌ id.; Ph. עלמת girl; Nab. Palm. עלם, עלים slave, Palm. fpl. harlots; 𝔗 עוּלֵּימָא, עוּלֵּמְתָּא, Syriac ܥܠܰܝܡܳܐ, ܥܠܰܝܡܬܳܐ young man, young woman).
